purpose: Source-verification corrections and additions after reviewing the direct-literature agent output; bibliographic identity is primary-source verified, while abstract-only method summaries may also use scholarly indexes.

records.title: Personalized Interest Graphs for Theme-Driven User Behavior
records.verified_claim: The eBay system builds multi-granularity LLM-generated user-interest graphs for theme-centric cross-category recommendation. Its abstract reports online gains for engagement with previously unseen categories, purchases, and buyer count.
records.crossinterest_role: Direct industrial method precedent for cross-category interest expansion; not a public history-to-future benchmark because logs, graph, taxonomy, and evaluation data are private.

records.title: When Relevance Meets Novelty: Dual-Stable Periodic Optimization for Serendipitous Recommendation
records.verified_claim: CoEA jointly models long-term group identity and short-term individual interests, and periodically co-optimizes novelty and relevance LLMs using incremental feedback; its abstract reports offline and online experiments.
records.crossinterest_role: Method inspiration for separating stable history from emerging interests and for periodic alignment; it does not provide a verified public future-novel-interest benchmark.

records.title: Serendipitous Recommendation with Multimodal LLM
records.verified_claim: The hierarchical MLLM framework identifies relevant but unexplored interest clusters and grounds them through conventional recommenders; its abstract reports live experiments on a private short-video platform.
records.crossinterest_role: Direct method precedent for unexplored semantic clusters and multimodal grounding; private production evidence, not a reusable dataset.

records.title: Breaking the Relevance-Diversity Seesaw: Hierarchical LLM Reasoning with RL for Industrial Novelty Recommendation
records.verified_claim: BALANCE decomposes novelty recommendation into Novelty Tag, Interest Topic, and Recommendation List stages, adds self-reflection supervision, and optimizes sequence- and item-level rewards with SIPO. The abstract reports offline and JD.com online A/B tests.
records.crossinterest_role: Closest 2026 industrial method precedent for hierarchical novelty direction and topic generation; its data and production evaluation remain private.
